0413Management and administration

Planner computer-use environment

earakely-scale/PlannerFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

Add a User testing task to a four-task website launch plan in the Planner project manager and save.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • GUI agent evaluation on a real desktop app
  • small file-editing computer-use task

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A verify.py script reads the app's saved files through the computer's data/get view and passes only if every check holds, with no model judge.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

pip install agentenv-framework==0.9.1431
hf download earakely-scale/PlannerFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir planner-request
agent-env run planner-request/bundle --task add-user-testing --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/PlannerFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir PlannerFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; model provider configured for agentenv.

Evidence

3 of 3 Claude Code runs passed.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
